default.summary: llm-d-router's built-in config, used when a run names none: queue depth, KV cache and prefix scorers, then the highest score.
default.yaml:
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
plugins:
- type: queue-scorer
- type: kv-cache-utilization-scorer
- type: prefix-cache-scorer
- type: metrics-data-source
- type: core-metrics-extractor
schedulingProfiles:
- name: default
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: queue-scorer
    weight: 2
  - pluginRef: kv-cache-utilization-scorer
    weight: 2
  - pluginRef: prefix-cache-scorer
    weight: 3

pd-always.summary: Disaggregated: every request prefills on the prefill pool, then decodes on the decode pool.
pd-always.yaml:
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
plugins:
- type: approx-prefix-cache-producer
  parameters:
    maxPrefixTokensToMatch: 16384
    lruCapacityPerServer: 31250
- type: prefix-cache-scorer
- type: queue-scorer
- type: prefill-filter
- type: decode-filter
- type: max-score-picker
- type: always-disagg-pd-decider
- type: disagg-profile-handler
  parameters:
    deciders:
      prefill: always-disagg-pd-decider
schedulingProfiles:
- name: prefill
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: prefill-filter
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker
  - pluginRef: prefix-cache-scorer
    weight: 2
  - pluginRef: queue-scorer
    weight: 1
- name: decode
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: decode-filter
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker
  - pluginRef: prefix-cache-scorer
    weight: 2
  - pluginRef: queue-scorer
    weight: 1

setup.script:
# the stack that priced this report (needs git and Go)
git clone --branch v0.15.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/inference-sim/inference-sim.git inference-sim
test "$(git -C inference-sim rev-parse HEAD)" = 762f1605ff27cd825d6b2cb2d9e991cd4b864c91 || echo "inference-sim: v0.15.0 moved off 762f1605" >&2
(cd inference-sim && go build -o blis main.go)
export PATH="$PWD/inference-sim:$PATH"

git clone --branch 0.5.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/inference-sim/blis-catalog.git blis-catalog
test "$(git -C blis-catalog rev-parse HEAD)" = b5550f750cb51571498577fbdc1c68f78cda67db || echo "blis-catalog: 0.5.0 moved off b5550f75" >&2
export BLIS_CATALOG="$PWD/blis-catalog"

git clone --branch v0.3.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/inference-sim/blis-registry.git blis-registry
test "$(git -C blis-registry rev-parse HEAD)" = 96bead697172ab7f2cf8346e04e65b837014d867 || echo "blis-registry: v0.3.0 moved off 96bead69" >&2
export BLIS_REGISTRY="$PWD/blis-registry"

# the commands run from this repo: router configs live here, scenarios/ is where you save each scenario
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/inference-sim/blis-config-search.git && cd blis-config-search && mkdir -p scenarios
setup.sweep:
# in the blis-config-search checkout, after the install script
python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install pyyaml
python3 -I scripts/run_experiment.py reports/muse-spark-open-816b-a42b-h100-chatbot-pipeline/spec.yaml --dry-run --catalog "$BLIS_CATALOG"
python3 -I scripts/run_experiment.py reports/muse-spark-open-816b-a42b-h100-chatbot-pipeline/spec.yaml \
  --blis "$(command -v blis)" --catalog "$BLIS_CATALOG" --registry "$BLIS_REGISTRY" \
  --out repro/

spec_yaml:
name: muse-spark-open-816b-a42b-h100-chatbot-pipeline
scenario:
  model: muse-spark-open-816b-a42b-nvfp4
  hardware: h100
  workload: chatbot
  gpus: 16
  slo:
    itl_p99: 100ms
  concurrency:
  - 8
  - 32
  - 128
  - 256
  - 512
sweeps:
- name: pipeline-batch
  narrative: Pipeline stages only pay once the batch cap is high enough to keep every
    stage busy, so pp should lose least at large max_num_seqs.
  num-instances:
  - 1
  - 2
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 16
    - 8
    - 4
    - 2
    pp:
    - 1
    - 2
    - 4
    - 8
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    max_model_len:
    - 8192
    max_num_seqs:
    - 16
    - 32
    - 64
    - 128
    - 256
    - 512
    max_num_batched_tokens:
    - 2048
    - 4096
    - 8192
    - 16384
    - 32768
- name: dp-batch
  narrative: Data-parallel attention splits the batch across ranks, so the batch caps
    should bind later at tp4 dp4 than at tp8 dp2.
  num-instances:
  - 1
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 8
    - 4
    dp:
    - 2
    - 4
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    max_model_len:
    - 8192
    max_num_seqs:
    - 16
    - 32
    - 64
    - 128
    - 256
    - 512
    max_num_batched_tokens:
    - 2048
    - 4096
    - 8192
    - 16384
    - 32768
- name: moe-collective
  narrative: DeepEP backends should cost more as dp widens, and low-latency should
    fit only at small step budgets.
  num-instances:
  - 1
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 16
    - 8
    - 4
    dp:
    - 1
    - 2
    - 4
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    max_model_len:
    - 8192
    all2all_backend:
    - allgather_reducescatter
    - deepep_high_throughput
    - deepep_low_latency
    - deepep_v2
    - pplx
    max_num_batched_tokens:
    - 1024
    - 2048
    - 4096
    - 8192
    - 16384
    max_num_seqs:
    - 64
    - 256
    - 512
- name: eplb
  narrative: Redundant experts should cost a little memory and buy nothing on uniform
    synthetic routing.
  num-instances:
  - 1
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 16
    - 8
    - 4
    dp:
    - 1
    - 2
    - 4
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    max_model_len:
    - 8192
    eplb:
      enable_eplb:
      - true
      num_redundant_experts:
      - 0
      - 16
      - 32
    all2all_backend:
    - allgather_reducescatter
    - deepep_high_throughput
    - deepep_v2
- name: kv-capacity-pipeline
  narrative: Narrower tensor groups hold more weight per rank, so KV headroom should
    bind on 2-instance and deep-pp shapes, not on tp16.
  num-instances:
  - 1
  - 2
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 16
    - 8
    - 4
    - 2
    pp:
    - 1
    - 2
    - 4
    - 8
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    max_model_len:
    - 8192
    cache_dtype:
    - auto
    - fp8
    gpu_memory_utilization:
    - 0.8
    - 0.9
    - 0.95
    max_num_seqs:
    - 256
    - 512
- name: kv-capacity-dp
  narrative: Data-parallel ranks each replicate attention weights, so fp8 KV and memory
    utilization should matter more at tp4 dp4.
  num-instances:
  - 1
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 8
    - 4
    dp:
    - 2
    - 4
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    max_model_len:
    - 8192
    cache_dtype:
    - auto
    - fp8
    gpu_memory_utilization:
    - 0.8
    - 0.9
    - 0.95
    max_num_seqs:
    - 256
    - 512
- name: cudagraph-pipeline
  narrative: Full graph capture should cut per-step launch cost on every cut, but
    only where the memory it reserves still fits.
  num-instances:
  - 1
  - 2
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 16
    - 8
    - 4
    - 2
    pp:
    - 1
    - 2
    - 4
    - 8
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    max_model_len:
    - 8192
    cudagraph_mode:
    - NONE
    - PIECEWISE
    - FULL
    - FULL_AND_PIECEWISE
    gpu_memory_utilization:
    - 0.9
    - 0.95
- name: cudagraph-dp
  narrative: Graph capture should help the data-parallel shapes as much as the tensor-parallel
    ones, memory permitting.
  num-instances:
  - 1
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 8
    - 4
    dp:
    - 2
    - 4
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    max_model_len:
    - 8192
    cudagraph_mode:
    - NONE
    - PIECEWISE
    - FULL
    - FULL_AND_PIECEWISE
    gpu_memory_utilization:
    - 0.9
    - 0.95
- name: expert-parallel
  narrative: Sharding experts should beat replicating them at tp16, and matter less
    once pipeline stages already split the weights.
  num-instances:
  - 1
  - 2
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 16
    - 8
    - 4
    pp:
    - 1
    - 2
    - 4
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
    - false
  engine:
    max_model_len:
    - 8192
    max_num_seqs:
    - 64
    - 256
    - 512
- name: disaggregated
  narrative: Splitting prefill from decode should help little on short chatbot prompts,
    since the KV handoff costs more than the interference it removes.
  prefill-instances:
  - 1
  decode-instances:
  - 1
  prefill:
    parallel:
      tp:
      - 8
      - 4
      pp:
      - 1
      - 2
      enable_expert_parallel:
      - true
  decode:
    parallel:
      tp:
      - 8
      - 4
      pp:
      - 1
      - 2
      enable_expert_parallel:
      - true
  engine:
    max_model_len:
    - 8192
    max_num_seqs:
    - 64
    - 256
    - 512
    max_num_batched_tokens:
    - 2048
    - 8192
    - 16384
  router:
    endpoint_picker_config:
    - pd-always.yaml
- name: pd-threshold
  narrative: Disaggregating only prompts above a few hundred tokens should keep short
    turns local and beat always-split.
  prefill-instances:
  - 1
  decode-instances:
  - 1
  prefill:
    parallel:
      tp:
      - 8
      enable_expert_parallel:
      - true
  decode:
    parallel:
      tp:
      - 8
      - 4
      pp:
      - 1
      - 2
      enable_expert_parallel:
      - true
  engine:
    max_model_len:
    - 8192
  router:
    endpoint_picker_config:
    - pd-prefix.yaml
    plugins:
      prefix-based-pd-decider:
        parameters:
          nonCachedTokens:
          - 128
          - 256
          - 512
          - 1024
